name: Independent seed robustness check for L=8, g=0.5, p=0
purpose: Additional validation within one unpublished GHZ-reuse analysis project. All planned runs are retained; no seed selection based on agreement.
analysis: Pool only the 20 new runs; calculate exact acceptance, pooled estimate, Wilson 95% interval, and standardized count deviation.
Compare unbiased between-run count variance with N*p*(1-p), using theoretical p.
Report every individual interval and its coverage descriptively; coverage is not a pass/fail criterion.
Check per-stage reach, rejection, readout, BSM, reset, resource, and accepted-error counter identities.
Preserve original records and table inputs; record source/environment/plan provenance.
stopping_rule: Run all 20 seeds once at 100000 attempts each. Technical failures stop the run and remain recorded; do not extend or repeat runs to improve statistical agreement.
interpretation: A reproducibility diagnostic, not proof of security or an exhaustive test of implementation correctness.
